summary.text: Named in Apollodorus only as the father of Anaxibia, whom Nestor married after inheriting sandy Pylos — a bare patronymic with no further attestation in the pinned corpus.

story.text: When Nestor alone survived Heracles' sack of Pylos, Apollodorus makes him marry Anaxibia, daughter of Cratieus, and beget the princes and princesses of the Trojan generation — Pisidice, Polycaste, Perseus, Stratichus, Aretus, Echephron, Pisistratus, Antilochus, and Thrasymedes. The mythographer names Cratieus once as Anaxibia's father and records nothing else of him.
